visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A professional cyclist wearing a distinctive green and blue racing jersey with Trek and Lidl branding leans over the handlebars of a glossy metallic green road bike. The cyclist's face is partially obscured by a green helmet, and the background is an outdoor event area with banners. (2) A male interviewer with short brown hair, dressed in a red and white polo shirt and carrying a grey backpack, speaks directly to the camera while holding a small wireless microphone. He stands in front of a large blue team bus under bright natural light. (3) A middle-aged man, identified as a mechanic, wearing a dark blue t-shirt with the Lidl Trek logo, engages in a conversation. His facial expression is neutral and professional. The background shows parts of the team's support vehicles and event infrastructure. (4) Extreme close-up shots show hands in black latex gloves delicately handling and inspecting a small yellow and black ceramic bearing. The focus is sharp on the technical component, emphasizing its precision and clean metallic texture. (5) Various close-up shots of the bicycle's mechanical components, including the wheel hub and disc brake assembly, prominently feature the blue Tripeak logo. The metallic green frame of the Trek Madone bike is visible in the periphery. (6) A collection of high-performance bicycle wheels equipped with red hubs and disc brakes are displayed together, showcasing the equipment used by the racing team. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the sleek carbon fiber and metal surfaces. (7) The interviewer in the red shirt continues talking, followed by the technician in the navy shirt providing technical details about the bike's performance while maintaining eye contact with the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我們現在和 Lidl-Trek 的技術人員、機械師在一起. [Logo]: Trek. (2) [Subtitle]: 你能跟我們講講我們騎的公路車嗎 以及公路車的一些規格. (3) [Subtitle]: 我認為我們的自行車是環法自行車賽中最好的公路車之一! Trek 是世界上最好的公司之一!. [Logo]: Lidl Trek. (4) [Subtitle]: 這就是選手要騎的車，一台 Trek Madone. (5) [Subtitle]: 我這次代表 Tripeak 來參加環法賽. [Logo]: TRIPEAK. (6) [Subtitle]: 他們生產陶瓷軸承. (7) [Subtitle]: 你可以分享你對於 Tripeak 的心得嗎 以及它們如何幫助公路車的機械性能. (8) [Subtitle]: 我們用這些軸承來製造公路車 我們認為這是最好的之一. (9) [Subtitle]: 性能和對騎士的幫助很多. (10) [Subtitle]: 看起來有了軸承和公路車，我們擁有最快的騎手 衝刺綠衫、綠色公路車。這表明，這兩者結合在一起 創造了最快的公路車!.
